title: Shoulders + Triceps & Upper Abs
restInstructions: There is no rest in between the exercises. Take 90sec rest after the giant set and 60sec rest after the super set. Rest about 60sec to 90sec between each giant set and superset. Rest 2 to 3 minutes between muscle groups. For Upper Abs take 30sec rest after the superset.
executionInstructions: Perform Giant sets and Supersets, there will be no rest in between the set, do three back to back exercises in giant set. When I put this (15, 12, 10) I mean that in your first set you should pick a weight in which you fail in the 15 rep range, your second set pick a weight in which you fail in the 12 rep range and your third in the 10 rep range.
liftingSpeedInstructions: Lift under control; don't just throw around the weights. Take one second to lift the weight and one to two seconds to lower it.
notes: Nothing; and I mean nothing will raise your metabolism more effectively than the challenging workout that I have laid out above! These face-paced workouts are definitely meant to get you cut up and lean!

cardioProtocol.title: HIIC TREADMILL: 20mins
cardioProtocol.progressionNote: Increase the speed and incline level every week to challenge you.

restInstructions: For cardio: follow prescribed 30sec intervals and 5min warm-up/cool-down. For Upper Abs take 30sec rest after each superset.
executionInstructions: Treadmill interval training alternating between sprint and recovery. Increase speed and incline level every week.
notes: Cardio is a very important aspect of your workout routine. As it burns fat at an extremely high level, It is vital to always keep your body on its toes as it responds at a higher rate this way.

title: Recovery
restInstructions: Full non-training rest day. Refill muscle glycogen depleted during low carb training days.
executionInstructions: Non-training recovery day. Focus on hydration, mobility, and scheduled carbohydrate refeed.
notes: Sunday is your recovery day means non-training day. A purpose of adding carbs on Sunday is to refill your muscle glycogen, which you depleted during low carbs day.
